note: Model-format and runtime requirements that the product must keep satisfying. They are NOT NER cases and never enter any NER denominator. fastner owns the model format; this file only states product expectations to be verified by fastner CI / ner-eval adapters.

contracts.requirement: A truncated model artifact (cut at 50% of its bytes) is rejected, never partially loaded.
Flipping one payload byte is detected by the artifact checksum.
An artifact declaring a newer format_version than the runtime supports is rejected with an explicit version error.
An artifact whose tokenizer_schema differs from the runtime tokenizer is rejected, not silently run.
A model loads from an in-memory byte slice with no filesystem access.
Identical input yields identical spans and confidences across repeated runs and separate loads.
Every emitted span starts and ends on a UTF-8 character boundary for every case in both product corpora.
Native and WASM builds emit identical spans on both product corpora.
Empty, whitespace-only and the pathological long-token workload inputs complete within a bounded time without panic.
Inference performs no network access and no filesystem access.
